name: Sustainability and Circularity in Textiles
description: Need for sustainability and circularity in manufacturing industries. Net zero emission, sustainable development goals (SDGs). Sustainable processes for fibre, yarn and fabric manufacturing, effluent treatment processes and zero liquid discharge (ZLD). Recycling processes and circular textile manufacturing, thermal, mechanical and chemical recycling. Life cycle assessment tools and techniques, impact assessment. Traceability of materials, standards and certifications related to sustainability and circularity, global trends. Environmental, social and governance (ESG) factors, social sustainability, governance mechanisms.
